A single continuous LIVE ACTION opera shot from the EXACT SAME LOCKED WIDE AUDIENCE CAMERA and same stage as the incoming guide. <Picture 1> is the canonical real Celes/Maria: preserve her face, blonde ponytail with blue bow, ivory satin gown with blue trim, natural beige skin and the SAME red rose bouquet. At the start she is right profile with bouquet in RIGHT hand and LEFT palm offered toward the existing right curtain. Continue this exact pose.
Instrumental orchestral passage: no speaking or singing mouth shapes. Her invitation receives no answer. Her ONE physical action is to bring the offered LEFT hand back around the bouquet stems, then turn her head and shoulders slowly toward the audience-left horizon. At first she looks toward the right curtain and then at her returning left fingers. Keep the RIGHT hand continuously gripping the same stems at the SAME WAIST HEIGHT. The LEFT elbow bends inward ONCE, fingertips approach the stems and gently close beside the right fingers, with no crossing arms. After that BOTH hands remain supporting the flowers through the rest of the shot. The left hand never opens away again; only small natural grip adjustments.
With both hands safely together she turns her eyes, head and shoulders from right profile through near-front toward a slight audience-left three-quarter stance. The turn is small and balanced, not a full spin. She does not step, approach the camera, lean forward, rise, sit, kneel or change size. Her chin lifts slightly toward the distant audience-left horizon, then quietens into resolve while breathing and weighted fabric settle. Keep the bouquet LOW AT THE WAIST throughout. Do not lift it toward the face or chest. Finish at the approved ending pose guide: same actor height, position and scale relative to the stone battlement, same two-hand low bouquet contact and slight leftward gaze. This is a continuous passage into renewed resolve, not a bow or finale.
Maintain the exact original full-length WIDE framing and distance. The crown of her head stays near pixel y100 and the blue waist sash stays near y360 in this1344x768 frame; the stone foreground remains at y690. Body height and head size stay consistent with both guides. Only the arms, eyes, head, shoulders and fabric move naturally. No actor magnification, forward travel, camera zoom, crop, perspective change or hidden cut. Exactly TWO ARMS and TWO HANDS: one right hand continuously on stems and one left hand returning once; no translucent extra arm, ghost image, duplicate hand, split fingers, floating flowers or duplicated bouquet.
The fixed stage, foreground stone, painted moonlit blue background and right red velvet curtain remain unchanged. Exactly one adult woman, no extra actor, shadow or background traffic. Steady neutral soft white light on beige skin and ivory physical satin; blue restricted to backdrop, bow and trim. No magenta or pink wash, flash, pulse, glow or lighting change. No text, subtitles, fade, dissolve, cuts, closeup, new voice, music or Foley.
